note: PER-MODEL calibration (2026-07-23c): Anthropic runs two tokenizer generations (fable-5/sonnet-5/opus-4-8/opus-4-7 at k~1.64; opus-4-6/sonnet-4-6/haiku-4.5 at k~1.06), so a single family k mis-estimates hidden tokens for one generation or the other. native ~= k*o200k + intercept on benign English prose; hidden-token estimate = native_completion - k*o200k_visible. Top-level k = family median, fallback only.
